Tour_01_Desc: Short tour for playing MIDI in Where Winds Meet. Next continues, Back goes back, Skip ends the tour. You can switch Sakura (pink) or Wuxia (dark) theme anytime in Settings.
Tour_02_Desc: Library = your MIDI files. Catalogue = community songs. Favorites, History, and Settings are below. Tap a row to open it. The playlist column stays on screen beside Library, Catalogue, Favorites, and History.
Tour_03_Desc: Patreon shows supporter perks. Discord opens our server. ? runs this tour again. Update appears when a newer version is ready. Minimize or close Debra — playback can continue while keys are sent to the game.
Tour_04_Desc: Import or drag .mid / .midi files (or folders) here. Search finds songs quickly. Double-click or ▶ to play. Clear only empties the list — your files on disk are not deleted.
Tour_05_Desc: Songs from the community (needs discord-catalogue.json next to the app). Refresh updates the list. Search and Style filter results. Play, double-click, or drag a row to Favorites to like it.
Tour_06_Desc: Build a set list in the middle column: type a name, + to create, Save / Open / Rename / Delete for saved lists. Add inserts a library song. ▲ ▼ reorder. Drag songs from Library or Catalogue into the list.
Tour_07_Desc: Songs you liked. Double-click to play. Drag here from Library or Catalogue. The ♥ on the player bar likes the song that is playing now.
Tour_08_Desc: Recently played songs. Double-click or ▶ to play again. Clear only clears this list. Previous and Next on the player bar move through the list you are viewing.
Tour_09_Desc: Shows the current song: title, length, note count, and playable range. The picture matches your theme (cherry blossoms or gold ink style).
Tour_10_Desc: Shuffle, previous, play/pause, stop, next, repeat, auto-play next (▶▶), and favorite (♥). F3–F6 work in-game. Click the progress bar to jump in the song. Volume changes PC sound (game audio too). ⌨ opens the key editor. Below: Smart Transpose, octave ±, track, layout, and language.
Tour_11_Desc: Theme (Sakura or Wuxia), game path, test keys, and player hotkeys (F3–F6). Advanced settings: note mapping, small timing tweaks, and help for 21-key vs 36-key in the game. Auto-play next sets the pause before the next song.
Tour_12_Desc: Open instrument mode in the game before playing. Keep DebraMidiPlayer.exe, Assets, and discord-catalogue.json in the same folder. Administrator mode often helps keys reach the game. Wrong notes? Try Smart Transpose and match your key layout (press F1 in-game for 36-key mode).
Tour_13_Desc: Press ? anytime to replay this tour. On the last step, Full guide opens the complete manual with troubleshooting. Have fun playing!
Help_HeaderSubtitle: Debra MIDI Player — Where Winds Meet
Help_S00_P0: Debra MIDI Player reads MIDI files and sends keyboard input to Where Winds Meet while you play in instrument mode.
Help_S00_P1: Import your own songs, browse the live Discord catalogue, build playlists, save favorites, and control playback from the bar at the bottom.
Help_S00_P2: Two visual themes are built in: Sakura (soft pink florals) and Wuxia (dark ink-and-gold). Change them anytime under Settings → Theme.
Help_S01_P0: Use the full portable folder: DebraMidiPlayer.exe, the Assets folder, and discord-catalogue.json must stay together.
Help_S01_P1: The app may request administrator rights so keys reach the game reliably.
Help_S01_P2: Before playing, open Where Winds Meet, enter instrument / music mode, then start a song in Debra.
Help_S01_B0: Extract the zip without dropping files.
Help_S01_B2: Press ? in the header for the interactive tour.
Help_S02_P0: Click any row on the left sidebar to switch sections. The active item is highlighted.
Help_S02_P1: Library, Catalogue, Favorites, and History each use the left column; the playlist column remains in the middle for set lists.
Help_S02_P2: Settings opens a centered panel over the workspace.
Help_S02_B1: Catalogue — Discord community tracks (Refresh to sync).
Help_S02_B4: Settings — game target, theme, transpose, layouts.
Help_S03_P3: Minimize / Close — window chrome; playback can continue while Debra sends keys in the background.
Help_S04_P0: Import adds MIDI files or entire folders. Drag .mid, .midi, or folders from Explorer onto the library panel or the main window.
Help_S04_P1: Search filters titles instantly. Double-click a row or use ▶ on the row to play.
Help_S04_P2: Clear removes all entries from the library list (files on disk are not deleted).
Help_S04_P3: Drag a library song onto the Favorites panel to like it, or onto the playlist to add it to the current set list.
Help_S05_P0: Shows tracks from your configured Discord server. Place discord-catalogue.json next to the exe (see the example file in the repo).
Help_S05_P1: Refresh downloads the latest list. Search and the style dropdown narrow results.
Help_S05_P2: Play uses the selected row; Favorite adds to Favorites. Double-click to play immediately.
Help_S05_P3: Drag catalogue rows onto Favorites to like without pressing the button.
Help_S06_P0: The middle column is your working set list. Edit the name in the field; + creates a new named playlist.
Help_S06_P1: Save stores the current list under the name; Open loads a saved file; Rename and Delete manage stored playlists; the ▾ arrow lists saved names.
Help_S06_P2: Add inserts the selected library song. ▲ and ▼ move the selected playlist row. Trash removes one entry.
Help_S06_P3: Favorites only hides non-favorite rows in the playlist. Drag songs from Library or Catalogue into the list to add them.
Help_S06_P4: Double-click a playlist row to play that song.
Help_S06_P5: Previous / Next on the player bar move within the playlist when that list is active.
Help_S07_P0: Stores liked songs by file path in your settings. Search filters the list.
Help_S07_P1: ♥ on the playback bar toggles favorite for the song that is playing.
Help_S07_P2: Drag from Library or Catalogue onto the Favorites panel to like. Trash on the panel unfavorites the selection.
Help_S07_P3: Double-click to play. Shuffle and Previous / Next use favorites when the Favorites section is active.
Help_S08_P0: Lists songs you played recently with time and length.
Help_S08_P1: Double-click or ▶ to play again. Clear removes all history entries.
Help_S09_P0: Shows the current title, duration, note count, and note range.
Help_S09_P1: Hero art, branch overlays, and accents depend on the active theme (Sakura vs Wuxia).
Help_S10_P0: Main buttons: shuffle, previous, play/pause, stop, next, repeat, auto-play next (▶▶), and favorite (♥).
Help_S10_P1: The bar shows progress — click it to jump in the song. Volume changes Windows master volume (game audio too).
Help_S10_P2: Bottom row: Smart Transpose fits notes to the game; octave ± shifts the song; Track picks one MIDI part; Layout and Language change keys and text.
Help_S10_P3: Tap More for mapping, Fade (see-through window over the game), and millisecond tweaks (Note / Chord / Mod ms). ⌨ opens the key layout editor.
Help_S10_B0: While Where Winds Meet or Debra is focused: F3 play/pause, F4 stop, F5 previous, F6 next.
Help_S10_B1: Previous/Next move the active list (playlist priority). They auto-play only while a song is already playing.
Help_S11_P0: Theme — Sakura or Wuxia; updates colors, wallpaper, sidebar banner, player corners, thumbnails, and now-playing art.
Help_S11_P1: Target executable — default wwm.exe; Reset restores the default.
Help_S11_P2: Window title filter — optional substring to pick the game window.
Help_S11_P3: Test key / Detect windows — verify Debra can reach the game.
Help_S11_P4: Smart Transpose — shifts MIDI into the playable range.
Help_S11_P5: Auto-play next — wait time in seconds before the next song.
Help_S11_P6: Key layout — must match the game (e.g. Debra 36 Keys). Edit visually or open the keymaps folder.
Help_S12_P0: Sakura: light pink palette, floral sidebar and player corners, soft landscape background.
Help_S12_P1: Wuxia: dark charcoal and gold palette, mist header decor, alternate hero and branch artwork.
Help_S12_P2: The guided tour (?), help window, and highlights use the same theme colors you select.
Help_S12_P3: Theme choice is saved in your settings file under %AppData%\WhereWindsMeetMidiPlayer\.
Help_S13_P0: Explorer → library panel or window: import MIDI files or folders.
Help_S13_P1: Library or catalogue → Favorites panel: favorite a song.
Help_S13_P2: Library or catalogue → playlist list: add to the current set list.
Help_S13_P3: Reordering inside the playlist uses ▲ ▼ or drag within the playlist list where supported.
Help_S14_P0: App will not start: run from the portable folder with Assets present; check crash.log in %AppData%\WhereWindsMeetMidiPlayer\.
Help_S14_P1: No keys in game: run as administrator, open instrument mode, use Test key in Settings.
Help_S14_P2: Wrong notes: enable Smart Transpose; confirm key layout matches the game.
Help_S14_P3: Catalogue empty: verify discord-catalogue.json and network; press Refresh.
Help_S14_P4: Missing images: keep the full Assets folder next to the exe.
Tour_14_Desc: Tap More on the player bar. Fade makes the whole window transparent so you can see the game behind Debra — useful when the app sits on top of the game. Mapping chooses how notes are played. Note ms, Chord ms, and Mod ms fix timing if something sounds wrong.
Help_S03_P4: Update — appears when a newer portable build is available.
Help_S11_P7: Advanced settings — note mapping mode, note/chord/modifier delays, and tips for 21-key vs 36-key Free Play in the game.
